instruction.text: What happens in a hospital? Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: Ill and injured people receive ((++treatment treats)) here. Even particularly ((complicated --simple)) procedures are possible.
However, hospitals have other functions as well: most ((++births holidays)) take place in hospitals, and they are important for medical research too.

instruction.text: Read the text and select the matching image.

atoms.a: Nina was taken by ambulance to the hospital’s A&E, where a doctor examined her thoroughly.
The doctor then takes an X-ray of Nina’s leg. The fracture is clearly visible.

hint.text: During an X-ray, a machine sends special rays through the body. As bones don’t transmit the rays as well as skin, muscles, and organs, they appear white on the X-ray image.
hint.label: X-ray

atoms.a: Nina is taken to an operating room, where surgeons perform surgery on her.

atoms.b: Nina now needs surgery to ensure the ((++fracture fraction)) heals properly. During the operation, the broken bone will be put back together.
To avoid any pain, Nina is given an anaesthetic. She inhales a gas that puts her into a deep ((++sleep hole)) so she won’t be awake or in pain during the surgery.
After the surgery, Nina will need to ((play ++rest)) and recover in hospital for a few days. She is put on a ward with other people that have also broken ((++bones hearts)).
Each ward specialises in specific ((++medical radical)) problems. For example, the intensive care unit treats people whose condition is particularly ((++critical normal)).

instruction.text: Nina notices that there are many other jobs at the hospital. Select the roles to learn more.

flip.text: Nurses provide patient care. They monitor their condition, change dressings, explain treatments and much more.
Nutritious meals are important for recovery. Chefs prepare healthy meals.
The hospital is designed to prevent the spread of disease. Cleaning staff ensure that it is always clean.
Hospitals are large and full of different equipment and facilities. Technicians are there to make sure everything is working properly.

instruction.text: Nina now knows some different places in the hospital. Can you match all the names?

feedback.end: Medical samples are examined in the laboratory.

atoms.text: After a week, Nina will be discharged from the hospital. Her broken leg will soon be healed.
